Container.Name: stockledger
Container.Overview: StockLedger: serial-number stock tracking with purchase/sale prices and margins, quotes, PDF invoices, expenses, and a UK sole-trader (cash basis) tax summary.
Container.Requires: Replace YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME with your GitHub username (lower case). See README.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Nightly zip backups. Best on a different share/disk from appdata.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Used for dates, week boundaries and the backup schedule

Config.Name: Backup hour
Config.Description: Nightly backup runs after this hour (0-23)

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: Number of newest backups to keep
